scope: Actual zeta and Dirichlet nonvanishing entrypoint ONLY; not independent full Hecke, followup or paper verification
audit_source:
import OAI.NumberTheory.DirichletL.Nonvanishing
import Lean

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  for name in [``OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re,
      ``OAI.DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re] do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms name
    for ax in axioms do
      unless ax == ``propext || ax == ``Classical.choice || ax == ``Quot.sound do
        throwError "Forbidden transitive axiom {ax} in {name}"
    logInfo m!"EXACT TARGET AUDIT PASSED: {name}; {axioms}"

set_option pp.universes true
set_option pp.fullNames true
#check @OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re
#check @OAI.DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re

-- Check the actual Mathlib target, not a renamed local analytic surrogate.
example {s : ℂ} (hs : (7/8 : ℝ) < s.re) : riemannZeta s ≠ 0 :=
  OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re hs
audit_output_unabridged:
EXACT TARGET AUDIT PASSED: OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re; [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
EXACT TARGET AUDIT PASSED: OAI.DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re; [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]
@OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re : ∀ {s : ℂ}, LT.lt.{0} (7 / 8) s.re → Ne.{1} (riemannZeta s) 0
@OAI.DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re : ∀ {q : ℕ} [inst : NeZero.{0} q]
  (χ : DirichletCharacter.{0} ℂ q) {s : ℂ},
  LT.lt.{0} (7 / 8) s.re → ¬(Eq.{1} χ 1 ∧ Eq.{1} s 1) → Ne.{1} (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s) 0
